description: This file defines functions and types for image generation runtime, including provider selection, error handling, and image generation process orchestration.

methods.name: resolveImageGenerationCandidates
methods.description: Resolves and returns a list of candidate image generation models based on configuration and fallbacks.

methods.name: throwImageGenerationFailure
methods.description: Throws an error when all image generation attempts fail, including details of attempts.

methods.name: buildNoImageGenerationModelConfiguredMessage
methods.description: Builds an error message indicating no image generation model is configured, with provider hints.

methods.name: listRuntimeImageGenerationProviders
methods.description: Lists available image generation providers based on configuration.

methods.name: generateImage
methods.description: Main function to generate an image using available providers and fallbacks, handling errors and attempts.
